name: chapter4_tau_min_hardware_timing
description: Hardware timing assumptions used to justify tau_min for the Chapter 4 scrub controller.
notes: The scrub engine is modeled as one protected SEC-DED codeword service per scrub clock cycle.
The certificate checks that one full pass over the protected memory fits within tau_min.
If the memory subsystem provides fewer effective words per second, this configuration must be updated.
